oral_examination.oral_examination: 25 Grade III loosening, no abnormality in the buccal mucosa, tap (-), and the rest is normal. 26, 27 The missing alveolar cavity is narrow, the gap between the missing teeth is OK, and the occlusal space is OK, but there is no difference in the rest. 27 CBCT shows: Insufficient bone height and insufficient bone mass

treatment_plan.notes: Avoid acidic foods within a week and avoid hot and cold stimulation. Maintain oral hygiene as directed by your doctor and rinse with mouthwash. Regular re-examination and follow-up treatment if any discomfort occurs.
